verdicts.reason: Five-column table includes all six elements with the noted product names; kitchen floor shows 8.00, 8.80 and a 3.70 m² excess, marked Conflicto.
Shows 1.08 and 1.242 m² for the shower floor and 1.44 m² for the countertop; notes undefined countertop waste and no backsplash or wall areas.
Flags 'solo para muros' tile on the shower floor as Conflicto, contradicting packaging; never presents it as suitable or anti-slip.
Marks countertop Conflicto and asks about water behavior, but never says sealing or protection is undocumented or asks to confirm it.
Adds unsupported technical claims, such as 'Brillo' conflicting with slip resistance and undefined edges compromising MDF performance.
